title: Electric vehicles: A global overview
description: Innovation continues to advance, with improvements in battery technology, range, and performance offering reasons for longer-term confidence. However, the industry's trajectory depends equally on the strength of its foundations: charging infrastructure that meets real-world needs and supply chains that can reliably deliver the critical minerals powering the vehicles. This report brings these interconnected themes together, offering a clear assessment of where the EV industry stands and what lies ahead.
